solutions.title: DB_optimon Solutions
solutions.description: Ultra-lightweight precise database monitoring solution minimizing resource usage

features.title: Standalone Execution
features.desc: Operates independently with a single executable file (<50MB) without external dependencies

details.title: Independent Execution Build
details.text: Operates independently with a single execution file without installing external programs, making management very easy.

details.title: Ultra-lightweight Resource Occupancy
details.text: Maintains CPU occupancy of 0.1~2% and memory below 30MB~120MB based on 8 cores with an executable file size of less than 30MB.

details.title: Disk IO Suppression Logic
details.text: Fundamentally blocks system occlusion by applying unique logic that suppresses Disk IO while running built-in SQLite for statistical collection.

details.title: Cost Reduction
details.text: There is no need to build a separate external data collection server, so no additional infrastructure costs are incurred.

features.title: Integrated Backup Solution
features.desc: Flexible backup scheduling with comprehensive support for Oracle RMAN and DataPump

details.title: Flexible Backup Schedule
details.text: Simultaneously provides daily to weekly schedule backups and immediate manual backup functions.

details.title: Oracle Exclusive Backup Support
details.text: Supports Pump backup method along with Full, Increment, and Archive backups.

details.title: History and Recovery Management
details.text: Automatically records detailed backup history and supports supervised Restore for safe recovery.

features.title: Closed Network Security
features.desc: Enterprise security designed for air-gapped environments, completely eliminating external connections

details.title: Perfect Internet Blocking Response
details.text: Fundamentally removed external connection points with designs specific to intranets, air-gapped networks, and closed network environments.

details.title: Bit Operation Security
details.text: Enhanced security to the highest level by applying bit-level operation processing even to internal data structures.

details.title: Optimon_gateway Separated Communication
details.text: Communication for external notification and external control is safely separated into a separate gateway pipeline.

features.title: Processor Lock
features.desc: Next-gen OS process security that blocks unauthorized processes and prevents resource exhaustion

details.title: Block Unauthorized Processes at the Source
details.text: Instantly detects the creation of unauthorized processes such as WebShell, cryptocurrency mining scripts, and ransomware in seconds.

details.title: Perfect Threat Removal (Tree Kill)
details.text: Completely eliminates not only parent processes but also child and orphan processes hidden in the background in reverse order.

details.title: Ultra-lightweight Operation & Real-time Notification
details.text: Maintains a constant CPU occupancy of less than 0.5% with Delta CPU operation and caching algorithms.

details.title: Baseline Freezing & 1-Click Exception Management
details.text: Detects changes by saving normal running OS process snapshots as a baseline (Baseline Lock).

features.title: One Page Viewer
features.desc: Intuitive one-page dashboard aggregating all core monitoring metrics to minimize navigation

details.title: One-Page Intensive Layout
details.text: Minimizes page movement and manipulation by concentrating all core monitoring points on one screen.

details.title: Intuitive Color Classification
details.text: You can immediately grasp emergency situations at a glance by assigning intuitive colors to each important control item.
